_comment: User-curated peer groups for STOCK_ANALYSIS Category 3 prompt 16 (peer multiples comparison). SEC's SIC-code company listing was tested and found too coarse for genuine 'closest peer' matching (e.g. AAPL's SIC 3571 groups it with legacy PC makers) -- edit this file directly to adjust peer sets. Tickers missing here get an N/A peer comparison rather than a guess. Peers don't need to be on STOCK_WATCHLIST -- any ticker with real US SEC filings (10-K/10-Q, not a foreign private issuer's 20-F) works, since the comparison reuses the same SEC EDGAR pipeline.
